devdoc.details: Stakers contract defines data structure and methods for validators / validators.

contractCommission().details: The commission fee in percentage a validator will get from a contract, e.g., 30%

isOwner().details: Returns true if the caller is the current owner.

maxDelegatedRatio().details: Maximum ratio of delegations a validator can have, say, 15 times of self-stake

maxLockupDuration().details: The maximum duration of a stake/delegation lockup, e.g. 1 year

minLockupDuration().details: The minimum duration of a stake/delegation lockup, e.g. 2 weeks

minSelfStake().details: Minimum amount of stake for a validator, i.e., 1000000 NEC

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions anymore. Can only be called by the current owner. > Note: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby removing any functionality that is only available to the owner.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

unlockedRewardRatio().details: The ratio of the reward rate at base rate (no lock), e.g., 30%

validatorCommission().details: The commission fee in percentage a validator will get from a delegation, e.g., 15%

version().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

withdrawalPeriodEpochs().details: the number of epochs that stake is locked
